title: The theory is neutral on materialism but fits it

statements.text: The higher-order thought account does not imply a materialist or naturalist theory of mind and is compatible even with substance dualism. It fits materialism, since the causal pattern from a state to a higher-order thought can be due to neural connections.

sources.quote: By itself, the present account of consciousness does not imply a materialist or naturalist theory of mind.
But it does square nicely with materialist views.
